subject: POC headroom ask — BrightCart concurrency sweep
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@brightcart.com>
To: David Kim <david@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC request: additional headroom for 48h concurrency sweep

Hi David,

We’re ramping the BrightCart POC into a 48-hour concurrency sweep to validate tail p95 and cold-start behavior. Planned window: 2027-06-01 00:00 UTC — 2027-06-03 00:00 UTC. Estimated token consumption: ~120,000 tokens (generation + eval hooks) and peak concurrent requests expected to hit ~320 qps for ~6 hours during the run.

Can you provide a temporary credit top-up and a short concurrency override for that window? We attached the load plan and a short traffic profile. If you need a formal SOW/PO route we'll start that with procurement, but given the timeline we’d prefer a provisional promo/top-up so the test isn’t delayed.

Attached: brightcart_poc_loadplan.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

—Alex
Alex Chen

Karthik / Vivek,

Forwarding BrightCart’s ask — short timeline: they want a provisional credit top-up (~120k tokens) and a temporary concurrency bump to handle a 48-hour soak starting 2027-06-01. Deal: BR-2027-0923.

I’m proposing we sanction a provisional promo credit and a temporary override (48h) conditioned on:
- BrightCart using the recommended quantized variant (redwood-3b-quant) during the run
- Caching/prefixing enabled for repeat prompts
- A signed acknowledgement for reduced retention for the test window (we keep logs trimmed)

If you’re OK with a product/ops-approved approach I can give the customer a go/no-go within the hour to avoid delaying their run. I’ll draft the runbook entry and create the support ticket if we proceed.

Attached: david_proposal_runbook.md (text)

-David

David,

I’ve reviewed the load plan. Technical notes and my recommendations:
- Approve a provisional credit of 100,000 tokens from product promo budget. BrightCart’s profile suggests we can save ~15-25% with quantization + dynamic batching.
- Grant a temporary concurrency ceiling of 350 qps (not unlimited); route to lower-cost GPU pool for background batches.
- Require that they enable prefix caching for repeated inference patterns and set a max response length cap for the headroom window.

I’m attaching a short ops checklist for the on-call runbook. If Sales wants to top up to the full 120k tokens we can escalate to finance/sales leadership for the extra 20k.

Attached: ops_burst_checklist.txt

—Karthik

I’ll approve a provisional promotional credit of 120,000 tokens for BrightCart (PC-BRIGHT-120K) and a concurrency override to 350 qps for the window 2027-06-01 00:00 UTC — 2027-06-03 00:00 UTC. Conditions:
- BrightCart must use redwood-3b-quant as their primary model for the sweep.
- They must enable batching and prefix caching per the attached ops checklist.
- Run must be logged in HubSpot and we must create a support ticket (SUP-14287) prior to start.
- Billing will mark the promo as one-time and not applicable to future runs unless approved.
